text: Lane A status for JNM director (SendMessage failed 10-13 ~20:00): 8 of 22 specs READY, 14 critic-ready waiting on the owner; new owner questions below, my pick first. Branch lane-a/app-plan head 475c918b; nothing merged or pushed. BUILT tests-first (unit tests green, tsc and eslint clean; build legs wait on /tmp/jnm-certify.lock, held by lane D since 19:05): FS-596 Capacitor 8.5.3 (99063752), so Android targets API 36, Play's rule for updates since 08-31; cap migrate's two out-of-scope edits were reverted per the spec (app/build.gradle '=' syntax, AndroidManifest configChanges '|density'), named for the owner. FS-598 the store identity (c7a8ec30): JUVO_APP_IDENTITY=store builds com.juvo360.app 4.0.0 with floor 415; unset is today's com.juvo.app; a bad value stops the build before writing anything. READY, not built: FS-602, 605, 608, 612, 613, 614. BQ-614-1 resolved by lane A: @capacitor-firebase/messaging 8.5.2 ships Package.swift. SPLITS from critic round 1: FS-611 (push devices: export and /privacy), 612 (the app's edges), 613 (identity on iOS), 614 (push on iPhone), 615 (old Juvo apps after T0), 616 (no Google in the app), 617 (the push job). NEW OWNER QUESTIONS (APP-Q1..Q10 stand): BQ-597-1 iOS floor: (a) 15.0, so every Juvo phone updates; Claude walks the oldest simulator to measure styling damage (Next 16 and Tailwind v4 aim at Safari 16.4); (b) 16.4, and phones below it stay on dead 3.3.5. BQ-603-1 push ask switch: (a) posture flag NEXT_PUBLIC_PUSH_SENDING, set the day FS-617 sends; (b) FS-603 waits for FS-617. BQ-603-2 registering without our ask: (a) iPhone and Android 13+ phones that already allowed Juvo notifications register on sign-in, /privacy says so; Android 12 and below always asked; (b) everyone asked first. BQ-606-1 /employer 404s today: (a) the app's employer screen points at jobsnearme.com/employer/dashboard; (b) add an /employer page (a split). BQ-609-1 lock screen: (a) 'JobsNearMe / You have an update on a request.', with no business name or message words; (b) the business name. BQ-609-3 FCM THIRD_PARTY_AUTH_ERROR: (a) fail that device only; (b) stop the run. BQ-610-1 Android upload: (a) Alex uploads the .aab by hand; (b) Play service account in CI. BQ-611-1 /privacy sentence: (a) 'If notifications are on for the JobsNearMe app on your phone (because you turned them on, or because they were on for Juvo Jobs before it became JobsNearMe): the address your phone gives us for them, whether it is an iPhone or an Android phone, the app's version, and when it was last registered.'; (b) Alex's wording. BQ-615-1 old Juvo apps after T0: (a) our 503 shows their built-in maintenance line, and our page says update; (b) spike faking Juvo's sign-in for its own update prompt. COMPLIANCE SIGNATURES needed (applies true): FS-597, 601, 603, 609, 611, 617. Owner prerequisite: the gates project (GATES-DB) for FS-601's trial-apply. CROSS-LANE: FS-607's 'Used the Juvo Jobs app? Sign in with the same email address.' needs the seeker import to create confirmed accounts; which lane owns the seeker import? FS-605 and FS-615 re-point sentry-wiring.test.ts's BASE (byte-pins next.config.ts), so any lane editing next.config.ts collides. FS-606 wraps src/app/employer/layout.tsx in a client gate. Process slip: a helper agent of lane A started check:scope --all without the lock; lane A killed it within minutes, nothing written. Full detail: docs/50-requirements/app-2-0-plan.md §10-§11 on lane-a/app-plan.
